EmailTemplate.description: For use by the Admission Services App Services team
EmailTemplate.name: Transfer Credit Inquiry (Student - Resolved)
EmailTemplate.subject: Your transfer credit issue is resolved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Arizona State University’s Admission Services about your transfer credits. We have resolved your transfer credit issue in our system. It may take up to five business days for the change to appear in your DARS audit report.
If you have any additional questions on course requirements, please contact the advising office for your major. View major maps and advising contact information for your degree program at https://asu.edu/degrees.
Thank you,
Admission Services transfercredit@asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
